gen-gf-oxanium-gf-krub: Oxanium draws every letter with one uninterrupted line, and its big lowercase looks sharp and a bit futuristic. And Krub follows in a plain sans with a pronounced x-height, its curves left unfinished where the pen lifts.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-kufam: Oxanium's wire-like strokes give it a look all its own. Kufam, a plain sans with a tube-like track width and generously open curves, can take a slightly larger size so its dominant bodies and low ascenders stay comfortable.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-lexend: Oxanium's big lowercase and open-ended curves give it away. It commands attention with uninterrupted monoline strokes, while Lexend, a plain sans with outsized proportions and open jaws, keeps its thickness steady around every curve.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-lexend-deca: Lexend Deca is a sans-serif with a plain, unshaded line and capitals that look small beside its big lowercase. But Oxanium is the louder half, its monoline strokes and daylight-edged curves giving the heading a distinctive, commanding edge.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-liter: Modern and unshaded, Liter has no stroke contrast at all. Its tall lowercase and wide mouths on round forms might want a touch more size than Oxanium's commanding monoline display letters need.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-mada: Oxanium has a wire-like line quality, with a high x-height and curves that end in clear daylight. Mada, a sans with a towering midzone and curves that refuse to close, gives that sharpness a friendlier, approachable counterpart.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-martel-sans: Commanding up top, Oxanium keeps a constant stroke from the top of each letter to the baseline, with no swelling anywhere. Martel Sans feels modern beside it.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-matangi: Matangi has strokes like twine pressed into a flat surface, with rounded letters left open and a hefty lowercase. Matangi sits comfortably under Oxanium, whose commanding monoline heading feels sharper and more angular beside that softness.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-maven-pro: Modern in feel, Oxanium stands out with a high x-height and uninterrupted monoline strokes that look distinctive in a heading. But Maven Pro, a plain sans with a welcoming gap in the c, does the quieter work of a high-waisted body.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-michroma: Contemporary and professional, Michroma gives each letter a wide berth, with a tall-bodied lowercase and stubby ascender tips. Oxanium, with no thick and thin parts in any letter, simply commands attention.
